tytul: Frozen rowan berries in vinegar with honey: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for rowan berries in vinegar with honey.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UW-Madison CIAS, raw rowan berries (European mountain ash, Sorbus aucuparia) contain parasorbic acid, described as a known carcinogen; heat treatment and, to a lesser extent, freezing may neutralize it, and the seeds probably contain hydrogen cyanide.

akapity: The source says only that heat treatment or freezing may neutralize parasorbic acid; it gives no time or temperature for it.
According to the source, freezing may neutralize it only to a lesser extent than heat treatment.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for rowan berries in vinegar.
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, fruit and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions.
